run:
import csv, sys
parked = set(['S-2s2xlwgf', 'S-6w34pn5d', 'S-d3lsp242', 'S-forvn2ly', 'S-jhuny2li', 'S-mt66jy4n', 'S-nwnif62g', 'S-qzdkyvqx', 'S-u5diy2cr', 'S-uzuvf3vo', 'S1405', 'S1425', 'S1552', 'S1555', 'S1556', 'S1563', 'S2161', 'S870', 'S871'])
r = list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv', encoding='utf-8')))
left = [x for x in r if x['outcome'] == 'unconfirmed' and x['used_in'].strip()]
bad = [x['id'] for x in left if x['id'] not in parked or not x['outcome_note'].strip()]
print(len(left), 'cited sources unconfirmed;', len(bad), 'outside the parked 19 or with no note:', bad[:20])
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
